abstract: STUDY OBJECTIVE: To investigate the laparoscopic management of ovarian cysts in adolescents and young adults. DESIGN: A retrospective chart review study. SETTING: Zekai Tahir Burak Women's Health Research and Education Hospital. PARTICIPANTS: A total of 282 females aged 25 years or younger underwent laparoscopic surgery for a presumed benign ovarian cyst. Patients were grouped as adolescents (ages 12-19, n = 79) or young adults (ages 20-25, n = 203). MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: Surgical approach, operative findings and the correlation of intraoperative diagnosis with the definitive pathological reports. RESULTS: The mean age of the patients was 21.2 years. At laparoscopic surgery, 89 patients (31.6%) had endometriomas, 47 (16.7%) had dermoid cysts, and 37 (13.1%) had paraovarian cysts. Ninety-seven patients (34.4%) had simple ovarian cysts. Pathological reports revealed that young adults were more likely to have endometriomas (34.0% vs 7.6%, P < 0.01), but dermoid cysts and simple ovarian cysts were more frequent (20.3% vs 15.3%, P < 0.01 and 60.7% vs 40.9%, P < 0.01, respectively).in adolescents. Eleven of the cases (3.9%) were found to have mucinous cystadenomas and fourteen (5.0%) to have serous cystadenomas. Four cysts were malignant (1.4%). Cystectomy was performed in 205 cases (72.7%), fenestration of cyst wall was performed in 53 cases (18.8%), and aspiration was applied in 22 cases (7.8%). The types of operation were not significantly different among adolescents and young adults (P > 0.05). The operative diagnosis was highly correlated with the final pathological reports (kappa value= 0.901, P < 0.001). There were no operative and postoperative complications in our series. CONCLUSION: With a careful preoperative screening, the laparoscopic surgery of ovarian cyst is an efficient and safe treatment for adolescents and young adults.
abstract_ja: 研究目的：思春期および若年成人の卵巣嚢腫に対する腹腔鏡治療を検討すること。デザイン：後方視的なカルテ調査研究。設定：Zekai Tahir Burak女性健康研究教育病院。対象者：25歳以下で、良性卵巣嚢腫の疑いにより腹腔鏡手術を受けた女性282例。思春期(12〜19歳、79例)と若年成人(20〜25歳、203例)に分類した。主要アウトカム指標：手術アプローチ、術中所見、術中診断と最終病理診断の相関。結果：平均年齢は21.2歳だった。腹腔鏡手術時、89例(31.6%)が子宮内膜症性嚢胞、47例(16.7%)が類皮嚢腫、37例(13.1%)が傍卵巣嚢腫、97例(34.4%)が単純性卵巣嚢腫だった。病理報告では、若年成人は思春期に比べ子宮内膜症性嚢胞が多く(34.0% vs 7.6%、P<0.01)、類皮嚢腫(20.3% vs 15.3%、P<0.01)と単純性卵巣嚢腫(60.7% vs 40.9%、P<0.01)も多かった。粘液性嚢腫腺腫は11例(3.9%)、漿液性嚢腫腺腫は14例(5.0%)だった。悪性は4例(1.4%)だった。嚢腫摘出術は205例(72.7%)、嚢胞壁開窓術は53例(18.8%)、穿刺吸引は22例(7.8%)に実施された。手術の種類は思春期と若年成人で有意差はなかった(P>0.05)。術中診断は最終病理診断と高い相関を示した(κ値=0.901、P<0.001)。術中・術後の合併症はなかった。結論：術前の慎重なスクリーニングを行えば、思春期および若年成人の卵巣嚢腫に対する腹腔鏡手術は、効率的かつ安全な治療である。
